name: abl_deltafield
description: DeltaField-RankBind (docs/DELTAFIELD_CONCEPT.md): one weight-shared bipartite ESM2-residue x ChemBERTa-atom transformer run twice (free vs coupled mask); the binding score is read ONLY from the difference field D = H_coupled - H_free, so the protein-prior shortcut is a structural zero of the score. d=128 keeps trainable params (~650k) MATCHED to the bilinear default (627k). Requires per-token ChemBERTa + per-residue ESM2 (attn_pool). All generated data on /work2.

_notes.matched_capacity: d=128 -> ~650k trainable, vs bilinear default 627k; d=256 is a deliberately higher-capacity variant (~2.1M).
_notes.zero_field_invariant: prop_layers=0 keeps the exact invariant (no cross edges => D==0 => score==b0 for all proteins); see v5_rankbind/tests/test_deltafield.py.
_notes.regularisers: lambda_sparse/tv/neg default 0 for the first margin-only run; enable per docs/DELTAFIELD_CONCEPT.md section 7 once ranking (check A) passes.
_notes.storage: per-token ChemBERTa cache lives on /work2 (rankbind_bench workspace); ESM2 per-residue store stays on the home shared store (running jobs depend on it; migrate later if needed — loader follows symlinks).
